三、词性分类大挑战 ⭐ 0/20

We sort the 20 words round by round: Round 1 — nouns (9), Round 2 — verbs (8), Round 3 — adjectives (3). Just tap a word: if it belongs to this round, it goes into the box by itself and you get a star. Not this round's word? No star — try another one!

四、释义猜词 ⭐ 0/10

Read the English definition and guess the word. Then choose its part of speech. Get both steps right the first time to earn a star. 10 rounds.

五、句中判词性 ⭐ 0/10

Look at the underlined word in each sentence. What part of speech is it in this sentence? 10 rounds. Tap 🔊 Listen to hear the sentence at normal speed.

六、阅读理解 ⭐ 0/6

Read each question and choose the best answer. Every answer is in the passage — go back to the article section if you need to check. Get it right to earn a star! Tap 🔊 Listen to hear the question at normal speed.

请仔细阅读每一道题，选出最佳答案。每个答案都在文章里——如果需要确认，可以回到文章板块查看。答对就能得一颗星！点一下 🔊 Listen，可以用正常语速听题目朗读。

七、关键信息快查 ⭐ 0/3

Key facts about the puppy: bath time, daily care, and the cat's name. Choose the right answer — the sentence from the passage will show.

八、词性戳气球 ⭐ 0/13

In each round, pop only the balloons with words of one part of speech. A right pop earns a star; a wrong pop costs one chance (3 chances in each round). 3 rounds: Nouns → Verbs → Adjectives.
